display_fil: Aprubadong form: petsa → concern at pinagmulan → ginawa → follow-up. Sa tamang health team member lamang, gamit ang awtorisadong channel. Kumpirmahin ang pagtanggap at susunod na kikilos.
display_en: Approved form: date → concern and source → action taken → follow-up. Send to the appropriate health team member using an authorized channel. Confirm receipt and the next owner.

heading_en: Adapt the message to the audience
display_fil: Kay Liza: hakbang at contact. Sa midwife: concern, ebidensya at tulong na hinihingi. Sa pulong: pinagsamang pattern na walang pangalan. Iangkop ang detalye sa layunin at tatanggap.
display_en: For Liza: step and contact. For the midwife: concern, evidence and requested help. For a meeting: an aggregated pattern without names. Match detail to purpose and recipient.

heading_fil: Ipaliwanag sa pulong nang walang pangalan
heading_en: Present at a meeting without names
display_fil: Halimbawa: tatlong pamilya ang may childcare barrier. Iulat ang pattern at kulang na impormasyon, saka magtanong tungkol sa posibleng pagbabago. Walang pangalan at walang pangakong aprubado na ang mungkahi.
display_en: Example: three households report childcare barriers. Present the pattern and missing information, then ask about a possible change. Include no names and make no promise that a proposal is approved.

display_fil: Concern → natiyak at kulang → hinihinging tulong. Suriin ang channel, pagtanggap at may-ari ng follow-up.
display_en: Concern → verified details and gaps → requested help. Check the channel, receipt and follow-up owner.

display_fil: Ang ulat ay sapat para makakilos ang tamang tao, habang protektado ang pribadong detalye.
display_en: A handoff gives the right person enough to act while protecting private details.

check.prompt_fil: Humihingi ang barangay meeting ng paliwanag sa missed visits. Ano ang ibabahagi?
check.prompt_en: A barangay meeting asks about missed visits. What should be shared?

options.fil: Ang pinagsamang childcare barrier at tanong tungkol sa iskedyul.
options.en: The aggregated childcare barrier and a question about scheduling.

options.fil: Mga larawan ng household forms para kumpleto.
options.en: Photos of household forms for completeness.

options.fil: Pangalan ng bawat pamilya at opinyon ng kapitbahay.
options.en: Each family’s name and the neighbor’s opinion.

check.feedback_fil: Ang unang sagot ay angkop sa pagpaplano. Ang forms at pangalan ay naglalantad ng hindi kailangang personal na detalye; ang opinyon ay hindi ebidensya ng dahilan. Ang indibidwal na follow-up ay sa tamang health team member.
check.feedback_en: The first response fits planning. Forms and names expose unnecessary personal details; an opinion is not evidence of the cause. Individual follow-up goes to the appropriate health team member.
